sentences.text: John Henry `` Doc '' Holliday -LRB- August 14 , 1851 -- November 8 , 1887 -RRB- was an American gambler , gunfighter , and dentist , and a good friend of Wyatt Earp .	dentist	dentistry	gambler	gambling	gunfighter	gunfighter	American	American Old West	Wyatt Earp	Wyatt Earp
He is most well known for his role as a temporary deputy marshal in the events leading up to and following the Gunfight at the O.K. Corral .	Gunfight at the O.K. Corral	Gunfight at the O.K. Corral

At age 21 Holliday earned a degree in dentistry from the Pennsylvania College of Dental Surgery .	Pennsylvania College of Dental Surgery	Pennsylvania College of Dental Surgery	degree in dentistry	Dental degree

He set up practice in Atlanta , Georgia , but he was soon diagnosed with tuberculosis , the same disease that had claimed his mother when he was 15 , having acquired it while tending to her needs while she was still in the contagious phase of the illness .	tuberculosis	tuberculosis	Atlanta	Atlanta

Hoping the climate in the American Southwest would ease his symptoms , he moved to that region and became a gambler , a reputable profession in Arizona in that day .	gambler	gambling	American	American Old West	American Southwest	Southwestern United States
Over the next few years , he reportedly had several confrontations .
While in Texas , he saved Wyatt Earp 's life and they became friends .	Wyatt Earp	Wyatt Earp
In 1880 , he joined Earp in Las Vegas , New Mexico and then rode with him to Prescott , Arizona , and then Tombstone .	Tombstone	Tombstone, Arizona
In Tombstone , local outlaw cowboys repeatedly threatened him and spread rumors that he had robbed a stage .	Tombstone	Tombstone, Arizona	stage	Stagecoach	cowboys	Cochise County Cowboys
On October 26 , 1881 , Holliday was deputized by Tombstone city marshal Virgil Earp .	Tombstone	Tombstone, Arizona	Virgil Earp	Virgil Earp
The lawmen attempted to disarm five cowboys , which resulted in the Gunfight at the O.K. Corral .	Gunfight at the O.K. Corral	Gunfight at the O.K. Corral	cowboys	Cochise County Cowboys
Following the Tombstone shootout , Virgil Earp was maimed by hidden assailants and Morgan Earp was murdered .	Tombstone	Tombstone, Arizona	Virgil Earp	Virgil Earp	Morgan Earp	Morgan Earp
Unable to obtain justice in the courts , Wyatt Earp took matters into his own hands .	Wyatt Earp	Wyatt Earp
As the recently appointed deputy U.S. marshal , Earp formally deputized Holliday , among others .
As a federal posse , they pursued the outlaw cowboys they believed were responsible .	cowboys	Cochise County Cowboys	pursued	Earp Vendetta Ride
They found Frank Stilwell lying in wait as Virgil boarded a train for California and killed him .	Frank Stilwell	Frank Stilwell
The local sheriff issued a warrant for the arrest of five members of the posse , including Holliday .
The federal posse killed three others during late March and early April , 1882 , before they rode to the New Mexico Territory .	New Mexico Territory	New Mexico Territory

Wyatt Earp learned of an extradition request for Holliday and arranged for Colorado Governor Frederick Walker Pitkin to deny Holliday 's extradition .	Wyatt Earp	Wyatt Earp	Frederick Walker Pitkin	Frederick Walker Pitkin
Holliday spent the few remaining years of his life in Colorado , and died of tuberculosis in his bed at the Glenwood Springs Hotel at age 36 .	tuberculosis	tuberculosis
Holliday 's colorful life and character have been depicted in many books and portrayed by well-known actors in numerous movies and television series .
Since his death , researchers have concluded that , contrary to popular myth-making , Holliday killed only one or two men .
